_README.purpose: Dangerous-terrain talents. Each entry is emitted by foundry-build.js as a native `edha-place-hazard` event rule on its talent (Events tab). At runtime the rule drops a scene-scoped Foundry v13 Region carrying the `edha-content.hazard` behaviour, which auto-deals damage to tokens that ENTER it or START A TURN inside it. Keyed by exact talent name. GM-side (Region creation needs GM permission).

fields.event: OPTIONAL event that places the terrain. Default 'use' (placed when the talent is used). Could be 'edha-deal-damage' for on-hit terrain.
fields.sizeByRank: true → size = [2.5,5,10,15,20] ft by the color's leyline rank; else use sizeFt.
fields.sizeFt: Fixed radius in ft when sizeByRank is false.
fields.damageFormula: Roll expression resolved against the CASTER at placement and baked to literal dice. [Tier][Die] = '(@tier)d(2 * @skills.<color>.rank + 2)'.
fields.color: leyline color for size scaling / region tint.
fields.description: Human-readable text shown on the talent's Events tab.

_README.pilot: Wired for Destruction (Razkael): Set Charge, Pyre, Fault Line. Set Charge's place/declare-trigger/detonate bookkeeping and Pyre's on-hit timing are approximated as place-on-use for the pilot; the ongoing hazard (auto-damage on enter / turn-start, persists for the scene) is the feature under test.

Set Charge.description: Destruction (Razkael). On detonation, each character within 10 ft takes [Tier][Die] energy and the point becomes dangerous terrain for the scene (auto-damages on enter / start of turn).

Pyre.description: Destruction (Razkael). On a hit, the target's space and adjacent squares become dangerous terrain for the scene (auto-damages on enter / start of turn).

Fault Line.description: Destruction (Razkael). The struck line becomes dangerous terrain for the scene (auto-damages on enter / start of turn). [Line shape approximated as a radius for the pilot.]
